IMPLEMENTED

Start where the code is written.

Claude Code’s pre-tool hook inspects proposed writes and edits in a configured directory. The prototype defaults to demo-app. It does not audit every possible way code can reach disk.

View source ↗
Engineering reality, in plain sight.+

What runs today

A scoped hook, local secret checks, provider classification through Mubit, repair hints, and local findings and spend logs. The classifier reads a bounded snippet, not the entire repository.

What needs proving

Correction submission, better results from trained adapters, and production adapter serving. Current Mubit docs expose adapter comparison in Try models, not an adapter model ID for app calls.

What the hook guarantees

It is an advisory development checkpoint. It allows writes on errors or exhausted budget, and after three blocks per file. “No finding” is not proof that code is secure.
